title: Single-molecule conformational dynamics of a transcription factor reveals a continuum of binding modes controlling association and dissociation
authors: Wei Chen; Wei Lu; Peter G. Wolynes; Elizabeth A. Komives
one_liner_zh: 该文通过单分子FRET研究转录因子NF-κB与DNA结合/解离的构象动态，揭示连续结合模式，虽为实验方法但聚焦TF-DNA互作机制，对理解动态结合机理有参考价值。
abstract: Binding and unbinding of transcription factors to DNA are kinetically controlled to regulate the transcriptional outcome. Control of the release of the transcription factor NF-κB from DNA is achieved through accelerated dissociation by the inhibitor protein IκBα. Using single-molecule FRET, we observe a continuum of conformations of NF-κB in free and DNA-bound states interconverting on the subseconds to minutes timescale, comparable to in vivo binding on the seconds timescale, suggesting that structural dynamics directly control binding kinetics. Much of the DNA-bound NF-κB is partially bound, allowing IκBα invasion to facilitate DNA dissociation. IκBα induces a locked conformation where the DNA-binding domains of NF-κB are too far apart to bind DNA, whereas the loss-of-function IκBα mutant retains the NF-κB conformational ensemble. Overall, our results suggest a novel mechanism with a continuum of binding modes for controlling association and dissociation of transcription factors.
abstract_zh: 转录因子与DNA的结合与解离受动力学控制，以调节转录结果。通过抑制剂蛋白IκBα加速解离，实现对转录因子NF-κB从DNA上释放的控制。利用单分子FRET，我们观察到NF-κB在自由态和DNA结合态中的构象连续体，在亚秒至分钟时间尺度上相互转换，这与体内秒级结合时间相当，表明结构动力学直接控制结合动力学。大部分DNA结合的NF-κB处于部分结合状态，允许IκBα侵入以促进DNA解离。IκBα诱导一种锁定构象，其中NF-κB的DNA结合域相距过远而无法结合DNA，而功能丧失型IκBα突变体则保留NF-κB构象集合。总体而言，我们的结果提出了一种新机制，涉及结合模式的连续体，用于控制转录因子的结合与解离。
